Description: Bigger-spread alternate preset (Divinity/BG3-style pacing): larger pool, wider cost spread between minor utility plays and big swings, higher carryover, and an example of the Asymmetric enemy-AP knob. Point this mod's [General] CostModelFile knob at this file to swap presets with zero recompile.

FocusUsedModifier._comment: Non-integer result is rounded up (ceiling) at resolve time -- see SPEC.md 4.

EnemyAP._comment: Demonstrates the asymmetric knob: enemies get a flatter, non-scaling pool with no carryover, so boss/elite difficulty is tuned separately from the player-facing spread above.
